# STRATA-Bench

> Spatial-Temporal Retrieval, Alignment, Transparency & Audit — a benchmark
> for AI agents on fragmented geographic and longitudinal market intelligence.

## What it is

STRATA-Bench scores whether AI agents can compile longitudinal market
intelligence from fragmented, geographically nested, temporally incomplete
evidence — without relabeling metro figures as downtown, silently
interpolating missing quarters, or plotting gaps as data. 36 sandbox tasks
across six failure families (GEO, TEMP, SRC, INT, AXIS, SYN), plus 3 live
probes. Apache-2.0.

## Quickstart

```bash
git clone https://github.com/movahedi-ca/strata-bench.git
cd strata-bench
python -m pip install -e ".[dev]"
strata-bench evaluate submissions/examples/extractor.json --format text
```

## Optional

Cite the motivating audit lineage: a 2026 comparative evaluation of six
frontier engines on a five-year condominium rental retrospective, which
isolated geographic-masking, OCR graph reading, non-uniform temporal axes,
and interpolation opacity as independent failure vectors.
